title: ricoila verna
intro: Ricoila verna, commonly known as Mexican mint marigold, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Ricoila verna include its analgesic, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Ricoila verna include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
